Multimedia Officer Job at Dame Chops & Events




        
    

        
        Dame Chops & Events is a professional catering and event management company dedicated to creating memorable experiences through quality food, excellent service, and well-coordinated events. We specialize in indoor and outdoor catering, event planning, food trays, small chops, corporate events, birthdays, weddings, and special celebrations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Multimedia Officer
Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Capture and edit video content in partnership with various teams.
	Brainstorm ideas, develop storyboards, and assist in voice-over script development.
	Operate and manage audio/visual equipment and software for content production.
	Produce collateral and update digital content according to brand guidelines.
	Perform technical tasks related to the setup and operation of audio/visual equipment.


Requirements and skills


	Currently pursuing an HND or higher in Marketing or Communications with a minimum 3.0 GPA.
	Strong understanding of Adobe Premiere or Final Cut, with basic knowledge of other Adobe Creative Suite applications.
	Experience with professional audio, video, and lighting equipment.
	Advanced skills in color correction, sound correction, and mixing/mastering are a plus.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
	Effective communication skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
	Comfortable working on a Mac.


Salary
N200,000 - N220,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
